assumptions.confirmation: completed 1-hour Heikin-Ashi body crosses the 1-hour Jaw while the 1-hour Alligator remains open in the pre-reversal direction
assumptions.alignment: latest completed 15-minute Alligator agrees with the intended direction
assumptions.structure: completed 15-minute ZigZag-style Heikin-Ashi support/resistance, Depth 18 / Deviation 5 ticks / Backstep 3
assumptions.entry: next 15-minute bar open after the completed 1-hour confirmation
assumptions.stop: structure dot plus max($0.01, 0.10 × completed 15-minute ATR(14)) buffer
assumptions.session: US regular trading hours only; no opening hour, final hour, or Friday entries
assumptions.weekend: force-close in the final Friday 15-minute bar containing 16:00 New York time
assumptions.costs: 1 basis point adverse slippage per side plus $0.005 per share per side
assumptions.intrabar_collision: stop assumed before target when both occur inside one 15-minute bar
assumptions.macro_filter: not integrated; long and short candidates are both included
